companyFieldUpdates.description: Eolian is a U.S. renewable-power and battery-storage investment, development and operating platform formed in 2020 from MAP Energy's renewable business. It develops, funds, owns and operates utility-scale battery storage, finances renewable projects and retains operating-project royalties while serving utilities, independent power producers, wholesale markets and large industrial and data-center loads. GIP reports operating-project royalties across 19 GW, while Eolian reports nearly 30 GW cumulatively funded or developed; neither figure represents wholly owned capacity. GIP IV acquired MAP RE/ES in 2020 and GIP continues to classify Eolian as unrealized. Eolian's July 2026 Flint Grid announcement identifies employees and GIP-managed funds as current owners. BlackRock's 2024 acquisition of the GIP manager did not create a separate Eolian ownership period. Eolian is the counted platform; Astral and project SPVs are underlying assets, and the 2021 Able Grid transaction concerned development-portfolio interests rather than Able Grid itself.
